publication: Public Vercel preview on feat/costa-diorama-map; main unchanged during browser QA

geometry_audit.method: Vertical rays at route center and lateral offsets; flags non-walkable geometry >0.18 world units above intended footline within 0.85 headroom. Visual inspection is also required. Handrail edge contacts are reported, not silently ignored.

visual_review.blender_art: Inspected full-resolution geometry and stair/bridge junctions
visual_review.offline_compositions: Production Canvas commands plus an SVG review facsimile of the UI; not browser screenshots
visual_review.browser: Initial preview tested in cloud Chromium at1180x757,500x757,400x606 and846x392 CSS pixels. Keyboard, pointer, panorama, locks, rapid selection, level entry/return and persisted selection passed. Roof overlap and short-landscape marker scale corrected; follow-up browser review pending.
visual_review.limits: DevTools disabled by browser policy. No touch-device emulation, physical touch, screen reader, or browser reduced-motion preference test. Reduced-motion rendering covered by deterministic integration tests.

preview.status: Ready verified in Vercel and game opened in cloud browser
